notes: SHIP v1.14.364 - CLEANUP: 20 dead PRECACHE_URLS entries purged, 4 orphaned tile icons deleted. Owner-approved as its own ship after the .355-.363 batch cleared, with the method specified: read-only sweep first, then one commit, nothing else rides along. Both halves executed as ruled. THE SWEEP RECONCILED THE OWNER'S TWO FIGURES EXACTLY. He approved 'delete the 4 orphaned tile icons' and 'purge the 16 pre-existing dead PRECACHE entries'. The sweep found 20 entries that were on disk but referenced by NOTHING - and 20 = 16 + 4. The four tiles the .359 banner rows orphaned were still carrying precache entries of their own, so they appear in both halves of his ruling. No scope expansion was needed or taken. PRECACHE_URLS: 74 entries -> 54. 228.4 KB that every cold install was fetching and storing for nothing. Families removed: the .132 nav-96 glyph trio (superseded by the .323 -v2-256 set), the mode-256 trio, the status-96 trio, the dom-256 pair, tool-crashcart (Crash-Cart Mode was RETIRED by owner decision), assistant-mark and ui-assistant-v2, the blocker and issues-alert actions, and the four .359 orphans. FILE DELETIONS ARE EXACTLY THE FOUR HE NAMED: phantom-action-deploy-upload-256, phantom-action-scan-radar-256, phantom-action-handoff-link-256, phantom-tool-masterdoc-256. The other 16 files STAY ON DISK, orphaned-but-retained per repo precedent (the old assistant raster set that precedent) - only their precache entry went. Deleting a file is a different decision from declining to cache it, and he only authorised the first for four names. TWO SWEEP BUGS FOUND AND FIXED BEFORE ANYTHING WAS TOUCHED, both of which would have produced a wrong ship. (1) A naive entry regex paired the apostrophes inside a COMMENT - the line "Owner override of the honesty-lock hold ('no use it')" - and invented a 75th entry pointing at a file called 'no use it', which then classified as MISSING FROM DISK. Comments are now stripped before parsing. (2) The first pass checked references against manifest.json only, and reported 23 dead entries. Scanning every consumer - dct-ios.html, index.html, forge.html, manifest.json and the docs shell - dropped that to the true 20: cc-ghost.webp, phantom-prism.png and phantom-shield.png are referenced by OTHER shell files and were never dead. Had the first number been trusted, this ship would have un-cached three live brand assets and broken them offline while looking perfect online. VERIFIED SAFE BEFORE DELETING: zero dynamically-constructed icon paths exist anywhere in the app (no string concatenation or template literals building an icons/ path), so a substring reference check is sound here - that was checked explicitly, because a built path is exactly what a cleanup sweep misses. STALE RECORD CORRECTED: phantom-ui-assistant-v2-256.webp was documented as the live assistant art from .281. It has zero references today - the assistant card was re-homed in the .344/.345 work and no longer mounts a raster at all. Entry purged, file retained. NO OFFLINE HOLES INTRODUCED, WHICH IS THE ONLY WAY THIS SHIP COULD DO HARM: every asset referenced by any consumer is verified still on disk AND still precached; every surviving precache entry is verified to resolve to a real file. A wrong deletion here is invisible online - the network serves whatever the cache lacks - and only shows up as a broken cold install in the aisle. GATES: three-stamp lockstep; sw.js compiles; 54 entries, no duplicates, none pointing at a missing file; the 4 deletions gone from disk with zero residual references; the 16 retained files confirmed still present; dct-ios.html diff is the version stamp ONLY (1 line - no markup touched); nothing outside sw.js, version.json, the stamp and the four deleted files is in the diff. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge reads v1.14.364. (2) Nothing should look different anywhere - this ship removes only bytes nothing asked for. Any visual change is a bug, not a feature. (3) THE REAL CHECK: clear the service worker, airplane mode, hard reload, then walk the app - Home, BUILD and all five banner rows, the nine OPS wall cells, TOOLS and its seven cards, the platform picker, rack detail. Every icon must still render. This is the ONLY way to catch a wrongly-purged entry, because online the network fills any gap silently. (4) ?legacy=1 unchanged. ROLLBACK: revert this commit - it restores all four files and all twenty entries together.
